term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (end of calendar year of death) for literary, dramatic, musical, artistic works; photographs, anonymous works, sound recordings, audiovisual works, broadcasts 50 years from taking/publication/making/broadcast
author_rights: Owner has the exclusive right to copy, issue copies to the public, publicly perform, broadcast, communicate to the public, and adapt the work (s.16(1))
orphan_works: No general orphan-works licence. Acts are not infringing for literary, dramatic, musical or artistic works if the author cannot be identified by reasonable inquiry and copyright is reasonably assumed expired (s.62)
fair_use_exceptions: Criticism or review with acknowledgement, and reporting current events (s.41); research or private study by an individual, unless a collective licence is available (s.42); also education and judicial exemptions
registration_required: No (copyright is automatic on creation in a material form)
enforcement_body: Copyright Tribunal (ss.202-209) decides licensing-scheme disputes; Minister responsible for the Act, which may be the Attorney General; police (warrants) and Customs (pirated copies at the border)
notes: Assented 19 Mar 1999; in force 1 Jul 2000. Berne member (Commons gives 9 Oct 1970), WTO since 14 Jan 1996. Moral rights, TPM and body not verified.
